words.meaning: Believing one's own group or country is superior.
words.example: His chauvinistic remarks offended many colleagues.

words.meaning: To tightly close your hand into a ball.
words.example: He would clench his fist when he got angry.
His conceited attitude makes him difficult to work with.

words.meaning: To stop someone from being angry; to make peace.
words.example: He tried to conciliate the angry customers with a refund.

words.meaning: An inner feeling guiding right or wrong behavior.
words.example: His conscience bothered him after he lied.

words.meaning: Wishing to do one's work or duty well.
words.example: She is a conscientious student who always submits work on time.

words.meaning: To desire something belonging to another.
words.example: She coveted her neighbor's beautiful new car.
